key_insight: IRMAE-WD’s latent singular-value drop marks a trained representation’s effective dimension, not an intrinsic dimension of turbulence; coordinate counts must be tied to accuracy or resolved scale.
engineering_relevance: IRMAE-WD offers more compact turbulent-flow representations than POD up to about 97% reconstruction, while POD needs fewer coordinates above that threshold.
method: Apply a 3D convolutional IRMAE-WD to minimal-channel velocity fields at Reτ = 110.
Vary the number of linear layers and truncate latent coordinates at the singular-value drop.
Use transfer learning to compare coordinate requirements with POD at matched reconstruction accuracy and smallest reproduced scale.
evidence_signal: Truncation at the drop reduces reconstruction rate by at most 0.01 percentage points, but the drop shifts toward fewer dimensions as linear layers are added.
watch_item: Do not interpret the architecture-dependent drop as intrinsic degrees of freedom; results concern a minimal channel at Reτ = 110.
paper_title: Effective-dimension estimation of a minimal turbulent channel flow via IRMAE-WD
